sqlite.sessions: SELECT id AS id, cwd AS cwd, branch AS branch, summary AS title, created_at AS started_at, updated_at AS ended_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM turns WHERE turns.session_id = sessions.id) AS turns FROM sessions
sqlite.text: SELECT role, text FROM (SELECT session_id, turn_index, 0 AS ord, 'user' AS role, user_message AS text FROM turns UNION ALL SELECT session_id, turn_index, 1 AS ord, 'assistant' AS role, assistant_response AS text FROM turns) WHERE session_id = ?1 AND text IS NOT NULL ORDER BY turn_index, ord
sqlite.files: SELECT file_path AS path FROM session_files WHERE session_id = ?1 ORDER BY file_path
